extraction.method: Enumerated every src/renderer/**/*.ts file in a clean read-only checkout; direct Phase 2 anchors come from screen-manifest.json; Phase 1 anchors and runtime-support relationships are explicit tables in the generator.
extraction.public_data_only: Paths, hashes, classifications, state IDs and rationales. No source text is copied.
